component.name: ToolRouter
component.summary: All-in-One Manager for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent & VS Code Plugins

description.p: ToolRouter is a cross-platform desktop app for managing and switching provider configurations for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and VS Code plugins.

ul.li: Manage multiple provider configurations and endpoints
One-click switch and sync to client live configurations
